_note: Curated odoo.tools symbols for Odoo 19.0. safe_eval takes keyword-only arguments from this version (odoo/tools/safe_eval.py: safe_eval(expr, /, context=None, *, mode='eval', filename=None)); it has no entry in this file. The flat odoo.tools.image_process re-export is dropped from odoo/tools/__init__.py, so the flat qualified_name does not resolve and is omitted ('removed' = absent per the schema status doc); only odoo.tools.image.image_process resolves. odoo/tools/__init__.py references date_utils, js_transpiler and pycompat in no form, but each is a module file directly under odoo/tools/, so 'from odoo.tools import <module>' resolves through Python's from-package-import submodule fallback and the three are curated with signature 'module' (odoo/orm/fields_temporal.py imports date_utils that way). Functions inside those modules do not resolve flat off odoo.tools and have no entries. ustr and pycompat emit a DeprecationWarning (since Odoo 18) and are 'deprecated'. html_escape is the statement html_escape = markupsafe.escape in odoo/tools/misc.py and is stable.

Also genuinely imported elsewhere in v19 core (odoo/addons/base/models/assetsbundle.py: 'from odoo.tools.js_transpiler import transpile_javascript, is_odoo_module, ...'). Different shape from image_process (see file _note): image_process is a flat FUNCTION name with no submodule-fallback available once its re-export line was dropped; this is the submodule's own file name, which always has one. Correctly 'stable', not 'removed' - investigated for issue #364 and confirmed, not changed.

Date utility submodule. Provides start_of, end_of, add, subtract. odoo/tools/__init__.py no longer imports it in any form at v19, but date_utils.py exists on disk directly under odoo/tools/, so 'from odoo.tools import date_utils' still resolves via Python's from-package-import submodule fallback - confirmed against a real v19 checkout. Also genuinely imported elsewhere in v19 core (odoo/orm/domains.py: 'from odoo.tools.date_utils import parse_date, parse_iso_date'; odoo/orm/fields_temporal.py: 'from odoo.tools import SQL, date_utils'). Individual functions (start_of, end_of, add, subtract, parse_date, ...) do NOT resolve flat off odoo.tools - only the module itself does; no curated entry claims otherwise.
